categories.main_business_segments: Zhongjin Irradiation primarily operates in irradiation technology services, including irradiation sterilization and irradiation modification services, disinfection supply services, and technical testing services. The irradiation services utilize cobalt-60 and electron accelerators to provide sterilization for medical products, food, pharmaceuticals, daily necessities, and packaging materials. Disinfection supply services cater mainly to medical institutions and medical device manufacturers, offering sterilization for reusable instruments and surgical packs. Technical testing services support irradiation services with testing, verification, and consulting, with CNAS-accredited laboratories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cobalt-60 radioactive sources and electron accelerator technology for irradiation sterilization and material modification. It has developed proprietary irradiation control systems, dose measurement technologies, and customized sterilization protocols. The firm employs advanced quality management systems aligned with ISO standards and uses Monte Carlo methods for dose distribution modeling. It also develops smart warehouse management and information systems to enhance operational efficiency and traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale enterprises in medical healthcare, food processing, pharmaceuticals, and packaging industries. The company serves multinational corporations and domestic leading firms, including over thirty Fortune 500 companies. Its services support medical device sterilization, food safety enhancement, pharmaceutical sterilization, and packaging sterilization. The markets are primarily domestic but include products destined for international export, requiring compliance with global standards.
categories.geographic_coverage: Zhongjin Irradiation operates extensively across China, with facilities and subsidiaries in major economic regions such as the Yangtze River Economic Belt, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle, and Bohai Rim Economic Circle. Key operational sites include Shenzhen, Shanghai, Tianjin, Qingdao, Wuhan, Chengdu, Chongqing, Jiaxing, Changsha, and Hefei. The company is expanding its network to cover more economically developed regions nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the irradiation technology supply chain. It procures radioactive cobalt sources and electron accelerators (upstream inputs) and provides irradiation sterilization and modification services (midstream processing) directly to end customers in healthcare, food, and pharmaceutical sectors (downstream). It also offers ancillary services such as disinfection supply and technical testing, integrating vertically within irradiation service provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating market leadership, expanding irradiation applications, and enhancing technological innovation. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on irradiation dose measurement, sterilization process optimization, electronic accelerator energy testing, and smart warehouse systems. It actively participates in national and industry standard setting and collaborates with universities and research institutes. The firm aims to develop new irradiation applications in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and materials modification, supporting digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fees for irradiation technology services, including sterilization and material modification. The company also earns income from disinfection supply services and technical testing services. Pricing is based on resource consumption, product specifications, and agreed irradiation doses, with contracts typically settled monthly or on a pay-as-you-go basis. The company emphasizes customized service solutions to build long-term client relationships and loyalty.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhongjin Irradiation is a leading domestic player and one of the earliest companies to industrialize irradiation technology in China. It holds a strong market position with the highest cobalt source activity and the most comprehensive network of irradiation facilities nationwide. The company is recognized as a gold-level member of the International Irradiation Association and holds vice-chairmanship in the China Isotope and Radiation Industry Association. Its brand names 'Zhongjin Irradiation' and 'Jinpengyuan' are well-known in the industry. Competitors include other domestic irradiation service providers and international firms in the nuclear technology application sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, Zhongjin Irradiation reported total assets of approximately RMB 1.14 billion and shareholders' equity of RMB 948 million. The company achieved operating revenue of RMB 358.5 million, representing a 3.99% year-on-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 108.9 million, up 0.73%. The firm maintains stable profitability and positive cash flow from operations, with continuous investment in fixed assets and R&D. It has a workforce of 641 employees, including 145 R&D personnel, and sustains a steady growth trajectory supported by strategic investments and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhongjin Irradiation differentiates itself through advanced irradiation technology, comprehensive quality management systems, and a nationwide multi-site operational network enabling consistent, high-quality service delivery. Its customized sterilization solutions, strict dose control, and traceability systems ensure product safety and compliance with international standards. The company’s scale and technological expertise allow it to serve large multinational clients with multi-regional needs, reducing logistics risks and costs. Continuous innovation in irradiation processes and digital management enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
